source_annotations.description: Manual head-echo ROI labels from range-time-Doppler matched-filter products.

doppler_model: f_D = (f0/c) * (u_tx + u_rx) dot v, positive for increasing bistatic path length

trajectory_fit_weighting.description: second-pass range/Doppler weighting estimated from first-pass robust residual scatter

linearized_fit_error.covariance_model: finite-difference physical Jacobian with station-specific residual scatter added in quadrature to nominal measurement scales
